scientific_interpretation: This is evidence against a BUILD proof based only on finite constant-curvature rod ODEs plus local smooth corner closure. The obstruction, if true, must use global base filling, horizontal traceless Ricci away from rods, determinant eigenfunction/spectral scale, holonomy/twist/non-diagonal fiber effects, Chern-Weil energy, or higher-order/global analytic matching.
not_established: No global base metric with these collars is constructed.
No full Ricci pinching inequality is checked on the interior/collar overlaps.
No collapse counterexample to Yau-26 or to P_4^+ is obtained.

The separated same-circle transfer still has mu<1 for A>0; the formal polygon configuration assumes alternating adjacent rods absorb the edge bubble instead of closing the same circle at a second bolt.
